messages.text: Morning all. Quick check: for address changes requested over the phone, are we still requiring MFA verification through MemberSSO before we update anything in CoreBanking? Got one in the queue already.
Yes, still required. Verify with the MFA push or the one-time code, and if they can't pass that, they need to come in with ID or use the secure message in online banking. No exceptions on phone-only.
Heads up, {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0028}} called asking to change their mailing address on both the share savings and checking. I'm handling since I'm their RM. Will confirm via MFA first.
Question from the teller line: a member walked up with a utility bill as proof of a new address. Is that enough or do we also need a photo ID with the new address on it?
Photo ID on file plus a recent utility bill or lease is fine. The ID doesn't have to show the new address. Just scan the proof into the member record and note it in MemberCRM.
Perfect, thanks Zachary. Processing it now.

Done on {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0028}}. Updated the address at the member level so it applies to {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00061}} and {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00062}}. Also sent the confirmation notice to the old address like we do for every change.

Another one: {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0058}} emailed from {{CLIENT_EMAIL:c_0058}} asking to change their address. Email alone isn't enough, right? I'm going to call back on the number on file, {{CLIENT_PHONE:c_0058}}, and verify there.
Right, email alone is not enough. Calling the number on file and passing MFA is good. Loop in Paul since he's their RM and can add a note on {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00131}} afterward.
Will do. Verified on the callback, address updated, and I tagged Paul in MemberCRM. Thanks all.
